title: Isandro and the Hollow Anew
author: Astrid Oyelaran
blurb: Isandro Dunmore, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
